Container.Name: Prusa-Print-Monitor
Container.Overview: PrusaLink status dashboard with compact, mobile and across-the-room layouts. Change PRINTER_URL and API_KEY before starting. Optional browser alerts require a selected MP3 in the writable Sounds Folder at /sounds and clicking Enable sounds. Optional RTSP/HTTP camera is converted by FFmpeg. Keep this dashboard on your trusted LAN; it has no login.

Config.Name: Printer status URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED: Replace X.X.X.X with your printer IP address. Keep /api/v1/status.

Config.Name: API user
Config.Description: PrusaLink HTTP Digest username. Default: maker.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: REQUIRED: Sign in at connect.prusa3d.com, select your printer, open Settings, then API keys / PrusaLink. Copy the PrusaLink API key (local password), not the separate Prusa Connect cloud API key. If missing, enable PrusaLink and generate/reset its password on the printer under Settings > Network > PrusaLink, then copy it here. Default username: maker; older PrusaLink installations use their configured username/password.

Config.Name: Printer refresh seconds
Config.Description: Seconds between printer polls. Positive integer; default 60.

Config.Name: Enable alerts
Config.Description: Set true to enable browser alerts. You MUST supply a readable selected MP3 in Sounds Folder; bundled files are installed automatically. Click Enable sounds in each browser.

Config.Name: Enable camera
Config.Description: Set true to allow camera viewing. You MUST supply your camera stream URL using CAMERA_URL. Toggle the feed in the web interface.

Config.Name: Camera stream URL
Config.Description: Replace this example with your actual RTSP or HTTP camera stream URL. Used only when CAMERA=true. Credentials stay on the server.

Config.Name: Alert repeat seconds
Config.Description: Repeat unacknowledged alerts at this interval. Positive integer.

Config.Name: Printer request timeout
Config.Description: Maximum seconds for a printer request. Positive integer.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone. Estimated finish and last updated are displayed in each browser's local timezone.

Config.Name: Default Layout
Config.Description: Initial layout for non-mobile devices: desktop, compact, mobile, or large (Across the room). Phones and tablets always start in Mobile. Manual layout selection remains available. Reload the page after changing this setting.

Config.Name: Web interface port
Config.Description: Host port for the web dashboard. Change if 8085 is already used.

Config.Name: Sounds Folder
Config.Description: Writable host folder. At startup the four bundled MP3s are copied here only when missing; existing files are preserved. The app uses this folder as /sounds. Change this host folder when storing sounds elsewhere.

Config.Name: Sound File
Config.Description: Select the alert MP3 by host path or filename. Default: AlarmSoundEffect.mp3. Other bundled choices: ClockChimes.mp3, Cuckoo.mp3, RedAlert.mp3. The filename is resolved inside Sounds Folder at /sounds; update both entries when moving the folder. Existing files are never overwritten.
